titleEn: Find the Score of All Prefixes of an Array
title: 一个数组所有前缀的分数
summary: 转换数组 conv[i]=nums[i]+max(nums[0..i])，第 i 个前缀分数为 conv[0..i] 之和，返回所有前缀分数。
insight: 一次扫描同时维护前缀最大值 maximum 和转换值累计和 score；每个位置把 nums[i]+maximum 加入 score 即得到答案。
pitfalls: 答案每个位置对应截至该位置的累计值

solutions.title: 滚动最大值与前缀分数
solutions.idea: 无需显式构造转换数组。

code.java: class Solution { public long[] findPrefixScore(int[] nums){long[] answer=new long[nums.length];int maximum=0;long score=0;for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++){maximum=Math.max(maximum,nums[i]);score+=nums[i]+maximum;answer[i]=score;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun findPrefixScore(nums:IntArray):LongArray{val answer=LongArray(nums.size);var maximum=0;var score=0L;for(i in nums.indices){maximum=maxOf(maximum,nums[i]);score+=nums[i]+maximum;answer[i]=score};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<long long> findPrefixScore(vector<int>& nums){vector<long long> answer(nums.size());int maximum=0;long long score=0;for(int i=0;i<(int)nums.size();++i){maximum=max(maximum,nums[i]);score+=nums[i]+maximum;answer[i]=score;}return answer;} };
